categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a long-standing network privacy leak where nodes rebroadcast incoming payments. As noted in issue #3828, an attacker can send low-fee transactions to target addresses and observe which node rebroadcasts them, leaking the wallet holder's IP address.
